description: Live intraday ranked buy-list candidates among US stocks and ETFs (the crypto book lists coins) while their entry windows (READY/SETTING UP) are still open. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
